entities.summary: Zara Nakhimovskaya (Kavnatsky) (Latvian: Zāra Nahimovska or Zāra Kavnacka; born 6 June 1934) is a Latvian chess player. She won the Latvian Chess Championship for women in 1958, 1959, 1961, and 1962.
